''See also: [[Council of Architects Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Council]] of [[Architects]] serves as the governing body for the [[Consultant's Guild|Consultant’s Guild]] and holds [[Authority|authority]] over the [[Gray Island]]. Comprising individuals with highly specialized talents such as alchemy, strategy, linguistics, history, and reading, the [[Architects]] are distinct from other orders like the [[Masons]] or Shepherds because they primarily remain on the island rather than traveling to gather knowledge. While the [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Guild Head]] manages certain aspects of leadership, they often rely on the [[Council]] for daily operations and administrative maintenance. The [[Council]] is structured with a High [[Council]] consisting of three members who represent the [[Am’haranai]]. These leaders, such as [[Yala the High Mason]] and High [[Councilors]] [[Kerian]] and [[Tyril]], are the only members who sit in public view around a white column. The remaining [[Architects]] typically deliberate from shadowed alcoves built into the walls, allowing them to voice opinions with anonymity. This architectural design facilitates honest discussion by concealing the identity of the speaker. Though the [[Council]] is a diverse group, recent mandates have prohibited non-human entities from holding seats. The [[Architects]] are known for prioritizing results and following orders from clients or the Emperor, though they maintain their own internal decision-making processes regarding contracts and guild affairs.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The High [[Council]] of [[Architects]] is a specialized group within the [[Consultants]] that maintains secret archives. Based in an underground home on [[Gray Island]], the [[Council]] was the group [[Shera]] was originally intended to meet. Members of the collective expressed perplexity regarding [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]]'s survival, and [[Lucan]] has expressed a desire to join their ranks. Furthermore, [[Yala the High Mason|Yala]] is known to speak with the [[Authority|authority]] of this High [[Council]].}}

== Of Darkness and Dawn ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Led by [[Kerian]], the [[Council]] of [[Architects]] serves as the ruling order for the [[Consultants]]. This governing body is a group that may include discontented segments and can hold formal sessions. During their proceedings, the High [[Council]] of [[Architects]] questioned [[Shera]] for information and possesses knowledge regarding the containment of [[Heart of Nakothi|Nakothi's Heart]]. While [[Lucan]] seeks to press the [[Council]] for change, the group is also aware that the Emperor is weakening.}}

== Of Killers and Kings ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Elected following the death of the last [[Soulbound]] to [[Bastion's Veil|Bastion’s Veil]], the High [[Council]] of [[Architects]] serves as a governing body responsible for the daily maintenance of [[Guild]] affairs. While they are typically not known for taking drastic action, the [[Council]] advised utilizing a ceasefire opportunity and took steps to accelerate [[Shera]]'s timeline. Although [[Meia]] places her trust in the group, [[Zhen of the Masons|Zhen]] seeks to avoid conflict with them, and it is noted that they should have been notified regarding the actions of the [[Gardeners]]. Furthermore, the [[Council]] remains hostile toward the idea of raising the [[Regents]], though the [[Regents]] would be the ones to deal with them directly.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Council of Architects]] advises taking advantage of a ceasefire opportunity.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c2" />}}</li>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The [[Council of Architects]] was elected when the last [[Soulbound]] to [[Bastion's Veil|Bastion’s Veil]] died.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 7</ref>}}</li>
